comment: dig.c dig() 557-559: a debug Valkyrie kills a jackal with #wizkill, wishes a closed door into the doorway on her room's west wall, steps into the corridor and makes a tame gnome lord there, wields a wished -20 axe (whose chopping effort never completes) and ^T-teleports back into the room. She applies the axe westward at the door; the tame gnome lord, which monster_nearby() ignores, opens the door from the corridor, so on the next dig() call dig_typ() returns DIGTYP_UNDIGGABLE and dig() stops silently at 559. A search and ESC end the recipe.
